title: Dumbbell Squat Jump
instructions: Grab a set of dumbbells and hold them down by your side with a neutral grip.
With your feet around shoulder-width apart, this is your starting position.
Lower down into a squat by bending the knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor or as far as comfortably possible.
At the bottom of the squat, begin to push through your heels and explode up. Your feet should be off the ground and flexed at the top.
Land back on your toes, then immediately shift your weight to your heels. This is one rep.
tips: Use caution when performing this exercise if you have had any previous back or knee problems. This is a high-impact exercise. Begin by using little to no weight.
